verses.original: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־ יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃ יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lāh lə·‘ā·nî ḵî- ya·‘ă·ṭōp̄ wə·lip̄·nê Yah·weh yiš·pōḵ śî·ḥōw Yah·weh šim·‘āh ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî wə·šaw·‘ā·ṯî ’ê·le·ḵā ṯā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: A prayer of one who is afflicted when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD Hear my prayer O LORD let my cry for help come before You
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, ouve a minha oração, e chegue a ti o meu clamor.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־ אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tas·têr pā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî bə·yō·wm ṣar lî haṭ·ṭêh- ’ê·lay ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā bə·yō·wm ’eq·rā ma·hêr ‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress Incline Your ear to me answer me quickly when I call
verses.literalPt: Não escondas de mim o teu rosto no dia da minha angústia, inclina para mim os teus ouvidos; no dia em que eu clamar, ouve-me depressa.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ־ קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵā·lū ḇə·‘ā·šān yā·māy wə·‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay kə·mōw- qêḏ ni·ḥā·rū
verses.literal: For my days vanish like smoke and my bones burn like glowing embers . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque os meus dias se consomem como a fumaça, e os meus ossos ardem como lenha.

verses.original: הוּכָּֽה־ כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־ שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hū·kāh- ḵā·‘ê·śeḇ way·yi·ḇaš lib·bî kî·šā- šā·k̲aḥ·tî mê·’ă·ḵōl laḥ·mî
verses.literal: My heart is afflicted and withered like grass I even forget to eat my bread
verses.literalPt: O meu coração está ferido e seco como a erva, por isso me esqueço de comer o meu pão.

verses.original: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl ’an·ḥā·ṯî dā·ḇə·qāh ‘aṣ·mî liḇ·śā·rî
verses.literal: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones
verses.literalPt: Por causa da voz do meu gemido os meus ossos se apegam à minha pele.

verses.original: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: dā·mî·ṯî liq·’aṯ miḏ·bār hā·yî·ṯî kə·ḵō·ws ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: I am like a desert owl like an owl among the ruins
verses.literalPt: Sou semelhante ao pelicano no deserto; sou como um mocho nas solidões.

verses.original: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־ גָּֽג׃
verses.transliteration: šā·qaḏ·tî wā·’eh·yeh kə·ṣip·pō·wr bō·w·ḏêḏ ‘al- gāḡ
verses.literal: I lie awake I am like a lone bird on a housetop
verses.literalPt: Vigio, sou como o pardal solitário no telhado.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm ḥê·rə·p̄ū·nî ’ō·wy·ḇāy mə·hō·w·lā·lay bî niš·bā·‘ū
verses.literal: All day long my enemies taunt me they ridicule me and curse me
verses.literalPt: Os meus inimigos me afrontam todo o dia; os que se enfurecem contra mim têm jurado contra mim.

verses.original: כִּי־ אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ê·p̄er kal·le·ḥem ’ā·ḵā·lə·tî wə·šiq·qu·way biḇ·ḵî mā·sā·ḵə·tî
verses.literal: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
verses.literalPt: Pois tenho comido cinza como pão, e misturado com lágrimas a minha bebida,

verses.original: מִפְּנֵֽי־ זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·nê- za·‘am·ḵā wə·qiṣ·pe·ḵā kî nə·śā·ṯa·nî wat·taš·lî·ḵê·nî
verses.literal: because of Your indignation and wrath for You have picked me up and cast me aside
verses.literalPt: Por causa da tua ira e da tua indignação, pois tu me levantaste e me arremessaste.

verses.original: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·may kə·ṣêl nā·ṭui wa·’ă·nî kā·‘ê·śeḇ ’î·ḇāš
verses.literal: My days are like lengthening shadows and I wither away like grass
verses.literalPt: Os meus dias são como a sombra que declina, e como a erva me vou secando.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām tê·šêḇ wə·ziḵ·rə·ḵā lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: But You O LORD sit enthroned forever Your renown endures to all generations . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas tu, SENHOR, permanecerás para sempre, a tua memória de geração em geração.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־ עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־ בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ṯā·qūm tə·ra·ḥêm ṣî·yō·wn kî- ‘êṯ lə·ḥen·nāh kî- ḇā mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion for it is time to show her favor . . . the appointed time has come
verses.literalPt: Tu te levantarás e terás piedade de Sião; pois o tempo de te compadeceres dela, o tempo determinado, já chegou.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־ אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־ עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rā·ṣū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ā·rāh yə·ḥō·nê·nū
verses.literal: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust
verses.literalPt: Porque os teus servos têm prazer nas suas pedras, e se compadecem do seu pó.

verses.original: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־ מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yî·rə·’ū ḡō·w·yim ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh wə·ḵāl mal·ḵê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory
verses.literalPt: Então os gentios temerão o nome do SENHOR, e todos os reis da terra a tua glória.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇā·nāh Yah·weh ṣî·yō·wn nir·’āh biḵ·ḇō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: For the LORD will rebuild Zion He has appeared in His glory
verses.literalPt: Quando o SENHOR edificar a Sião, aparecerá na sua glória.

verses.original: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־ תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא־ בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pā·nāh ’el- tə·p̄il·laṯ hā·‘ar·‘ār wə·lō- ḇā·zāh ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯām
verses.literal: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute He will not despise their prayer
verses.literalPt: Ele atenderá à oração do desamparado, e não desprezará a sua oração.

verses.original: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: tik·kā·ṯeḇ zōṯ lə·ḏō·wr ’a·ḥă·rō·wn wə·‘am niḇ·rā yə·hal·lel- yāh
verses.literal: Let this be written for the generation to come so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD
verses.literalPt: Isto se escreverá para a geração futura; e o povo que se criar louvará ao SENHOR.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם׀ אֶל־ אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hiš·qîp̄ mim·mə·rō·wm qā·ḏə·šōw Yah·weh miš·šā·ma·yim ’el- ’e·reṣ hib·bîṭ
verses.literal: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
verses.literalPt: Pois olhou desde o alto do seu santuário, desde os céus o SENHOR contemplou a terra,

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liš·mō·a‘ ’en·qaṯ ’ā·sîr lə·p̄at·tê·aḥ bə·nê ṯə·mū·ṯāh
verses.literal: to hear a prisoner’s groaning to release those condemned to death
verses.literalPt: Para ouvir o gemido dos presos, para soltar os sentenciados à morte;

verses.original: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·sap·pêr bə·ṣî·yō·wn šêm Yah·weh ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯōw bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Para anunciarem o nome do SENHOR em Sião, e o seu louvor em Jerusalém,

verses.original: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·hiq·qā·ḇêṣ ‘am·mîm yaḥ·dāw ū·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: when peoples . . . and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quando os povos se ajuntarem, e os reinos, para servirem ao SENHOR.

verses.original: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ כֹּחוֹ קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘in·nāh ḇad·de·reḵ kō·ḥō qiṣ·ṣar yā·māy
verses.literal: He has broken my strength on the way He has cut short my days
verses.literalPt: Abateu a minha força no caminho; abreviou os meus dias.

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־ תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mar ’ê·lî ’al- ta·‘ă·lê·nî ba·ḥă·ṣî yā·māy bə·ḏō·wr dō·w·rîm šə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: I say O my God do not take me in the midst of my days Your years go on through all generations . . .
verses.literalPt: Dizia eu: Meu Deus, não me leves no meio dos meus dias, os teus anos são por todas as gerações.

verses.original: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nîm hā·’ā·reṣ yā·saḏ·tā ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth and the heavens are the work of Your hands
verses.literalPt: Desde a antiguidade fundaste a terra, e os céus são obra das tuas mãos.

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה׀ יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yō·ḇê·ḏū wə·’at·tāh ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ wə·ḵul·lām kab·be·ḡeḏ yiḇ·lū kal·lə·ḇūš ta·ḥă·lî·p̄êm wə·ya·ḥă·lō·p̄ū
verses.literal: They will perish but You remain they will all wear out like a garment Like clothing You will change them and they will be passed on
verses.literalPt: Eles perecerão, mas tu permanecerás; todos eles se envelhecerão como um vestido; como roupa os mudarás, e ficarão mudados.

verses.original: וְאַתָּה־ ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh- hū ū·šə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā lō yit·tām·mū
verses.literal: But You remain the same and Your years will never end
verses.literalPt: Porém tu és o mesmo, e os teus anos nunca terão fim.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā yiš·kō·w·nū wə·zar·‘ām lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā yik·kō·wn
verses.literal: The children of Your servants will dwell securely and their descendants will be established before You
verses.literalPt: Os filhos dos teus servos continuarão, e a sua semente ficará firmada perante ti.
